_doc: Blog EN · Catering Checklists Kit Pro (catering/SPEC D1, 18-oct-2026). El id es el del CATÁLOGO (products-catalog.ts),
que con urlByLang.en pinta la landing EN /en/digital-products/catering-checklist-templates y $19.
Posts: los dos del blog EN que tratan el catering de verdad: Catering AI+ (128 menciones de catering/banquet/wedding)
y Cloud Kitchen Business Models (25, con su «Model 7: Catering Cloud Kitchen»: furgonetas refrigeradas, chafing
dishes, eventos corporativos). El siguiente (Allergen ID, 8) solo nombra el catering en prompts sueltos: fuera.
Víctimas = SLUGS EN de la landing, por relevancia: el Restaurant Financial Plan Kit en el de Catering AI+ (se quedan
el HACCP Kit por la cadena de frío y el Food Cost Kit por el costing del post) y el eBook de prompts en el de cloud
kitchens (se quedan Inventory y Scheduling, que un cloud kitchen usa a diario).
Nunca el Restaurant, el Bar ni el Coffee Shop Checklists Kit Pro, hermanos de línea y venta cruzada del dashboard.

prompt-library-catering.parrafo: Prompts plan the event; checklists run it on the day. The {ENLACE} writes that routine down in Excel: production from the BEO and packing in hotel pans and insulated carriers, transport with holding temperatures logged (135 °F or above hot, 41 °F or below cold), venue setup and breakdown, a checklist each for the event chef, banquet captain, server and bartender, and the deposit, settlement and balance of every event.

cloud-kitchen-business-models.parrafo: A catering kitchen lives or dies on what happens after the food leaves the building. The {ENLACE} covers that side with the tasks already written: a commissary opening and closing checklist (the day's BEOs, a route sheet for each vehicle, insulated carriers loaded with the departure temperature logged), transport and delivery, venue setup and breakdown, and the deposit, invoice and balance of each event.
